description: Tests the ability of a user to navigate between different tabs on the dashboard (e.g., RoostGPT, Admin, Connectors, etc.) and verify correct page content loads.
steps: Verify that the Generations tab is active by default.
Click on the 'Test Suites' tab with selector '//a[@href='/roostgpt/tests' and contains(@class, 'headerButton_collabButton__1E3Qx')]'.
Wait for the Test Suites page to load and verify its content.
Click on the 'Analysis' tab with selector '//a[@href='/roostgpt/analyses' and contains(@class, 'headerButton_collabButton__1E3Qx')]'.
Verify that the Analysis page is displayed correctly.
Return to the Generations tab and verify the content reloads as expected.
expected_results: Correct content loads when navigating to each tab.
No errors or visual glitches during navigation.
edge_cases: Switching tabs without waiting for the previous tab to load.
Navigating back to a cached tab.
Clicking the same tab multiple times.
data_requirements: Default configuration for tabs and pages.
No broken links in tab navigation.
UI must be fully loaded before test execution.
dependencies: All tabs must be functional and accessible.
User must have permissions to access all tabs.
Network and backend services must be operational.
api_interactions: API calls to load data for each tab.
Validation of user permissions for each tab.
performance_metrics: Tab switching time must not exceed 1 second.
Page load time for each tab must be under 3 seconds.
accessibility_requirements: Tabs must be navigable using keyboard arrows.
Active tab must have a clear visual indicator.
Screen reader must announce the active tab.
